schemas.candidates:
CREATE TABLE candidates (
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(run_id),
    candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
    parent_candidate_id TEXT,
    origin TEXT NOT NULL,
    model_call_id TEXT,
    code_path TEXT NOT NULL,
    code_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (run_id, candidate_id)
)
schemas.comparison_runs:
CREATE TABLE comparison_runs (
    comparison_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES comparisons(comparison_id),
    seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
    task_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    repeat INTEGER NOT NULL,
    run_id TEXT,
    error TEXT, arm TEXT, position INTEGER,
    PRIMARY KEY (comparison_id, seq)
)
schemas.comparisons:
CREATE TABLE comparisons (
    comparison_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    label TEXT,
    plan_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    summary_json TEXT,
    stop_requested INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    ended_at TEXT
)
schemas.evaluations:
CREATE TABLE evaluations (
    evaluation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id TEXT,
    candidate_id TEXT,
    task_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    dataset TEXT NOT NULL,
    dataset_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    executed INTEGER NOT NULL,
    format_ok INTEGER,
    correct INTEGER,
    improved INTEGER,
    goal_met INTEGER,
    speedup REAL,
    candidate_median_s REAL,
    baseline_median_s REAL,
    detail_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    evaluator_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    ended_at TEXT NOT NULL
)
schemas.events:
CREATE TABLE events (
    event_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    ts TEXT NOT NULL,
    type TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL
)
schemas.experiences:
CREATE TABLE experiences (
    experience_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    family TEXT NOT NULL,
    task_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    split TEXT NOT NULL,
    outcome TEXT NOT NULL,
    conditions_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    hypothesis TEXT,
    result_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    resources_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)
schemas.model_calls:
CREATE TABLE model_calls (
    call_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(run_id),
    provider TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT NOT NULL,
    model_requested TEXT NOT NULL,
    model_returned TEXT,
    reasoning_effort TEXT,
    max_output_tokens INTEGER,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    error_kind TEXT,
    error_message TEXT,
    request_id TEXT,
    input_tokens INTEGER,
    cached_input_tokens INTEGER,
    output_tokens INTEGER,
    reasoning_tokens INTEGER,
    usage_source TEXT NOT NULL,
    estimated_input_tokens INTEGER,
    cost_usd REAL,
    cost_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    price_version TEXT,
    latency_s REAL,
    request_path TEXT,
    response_path TEXT,
    started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    ended_at TEXT
)
schemas.pointer_history:
CREATE TABLE pointer_history (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    ts TEXT NOT NULL,
    from_snapshot_id TEXT,
    to_snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    reason TEXT,
    actor TEXT NOT NULL
)
schemas.run_experiences:
CREATE TABLE run_experiences (
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(run_id),
    experience_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES experiences(experience_id),
    rank INTEGER NOT NULL,
    matching_features INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (run_id, experience_id)
)
schemas.runs:
CREATE TABLE runs (
    run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(task_id),
    mode TEXT NOT NULL,
    snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    config_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    config_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    stop_reason TEXT,
    stop_detail TEXT,
    best_candidate_id TEXT,
    final_evaluation_id TEXT,
    stop_requested INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    loop_ended_at TEXT,
    ended_at TEXT
, retrieval_json TEXT, published_snapshot_id TEXT)
schemas.sessions:
CREATE TABLE sessions (
    session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    learn_task TEXT NOT NULL,
    eval_task TEXT NOT NULL,
    base_snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    phase TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    learn_run_id TEXT,
    new_snapshot_id TEXT,
    comparison_id TEXT,
    detail TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    ended_at TEXT
)
schemas.settings:
CREATE TABLE settings (
    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    value TEXT NOT NULL
)
schemas.snapshot_items:
CREATE TABLE snapshot_items (
    snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES snapshots(snapshot_id),
    experience_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES experiences(experience_id),
    PRIMARY KEY (snapshot_id, experience_id)
)
schemas.snapshots:
CREATE TABLE snapshots (
    snapshot_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    version INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    parent_snapshot_id TEXT,
    source_run_id TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    diff_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
)
schemas.steps:
CREATE TABLE steps (
    step_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(run_id),
    seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
    actor TEXT NOT NULL,
    action TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    purpose TEXT,
    expected_result TEXT,
    verification TEXT,
    hypothesis TEXT,
    params_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    result_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    next_decision TEXT,
    model_call_id TEXT,
    tool_call_id TEXT,
    candidate_id TEXT,
    evaluation_id TEXT,
    started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    ended_at TEXT,
    UNIQUE (run_id, seq)
)
schemas.tasks:
CREATE TABLE tasks (
    task_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    family TEXT NOT NULL,
    split TEXT NOT NULL,
    manifest_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    manifest_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    registered_at TEXT NOT NULL
)
schemas.tool_calls:
CREATE TABLE tool_calls (
    call_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(run_id),
    tool TEXT NOT NULL,
    params_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    error_kind TEXT,
    error_message TEXT,
    duration_s REAL,
    output_path TEXT,
    started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    ended_at TEXT
)
